meta.scope_note: Per original spec, 'Vol.2' = light novel Vol.2 'RAVEN'S NEST' (Sept 9, 2010). Architecture is volume-agnostic. Anime (24 eps, covers LN vols 1-9) is treated as an adaptation reference, not the primary source for Vol.2 scene content.

tag_legend.HARD_CANON: Verified across >=1 authoritative source (Wikipedia, official wiki, Fandom, publisher, Baka-Tsuki/archive.org).
tag_legend.INFERRED: Reasonable derivation from canon; not directly quoted but consistent with source material.
tag_legend.UNCERTAIN: Flagged for verification; do not front-load into scripts without explicit sign-off.

premise.text: Japan was thrown into chaos by onmyouji (magicians). Harutora Tsuchimikado was born into an onmyouji family but has no power; his estranged childhood friend Natsume appears and holds him to a childhood promise to become her shikigami (familiar).

history_backbone.text: Onmyodou magic was used by Japan in World War II. Yakou Tsuchimikado performed the 'Taizan Fukun Ritual' intended to make Japan a formidable force; it went wrong, producing the 'Great Spiritual Disaster' (Great Disaster). The Onmyo Agency was established afterward to monitor supernatural activity and combat spirits/demons.

yakou_reincarnation_mechanics.text: Yakou's full backstory and 'reincarnation' mechanics are deliberately obscured early. Later reveal (NOT Vol.2 material): Harutora is the real heir of the Tsuchimikados; his powers are sealed by his father and Natsume is adopted into the family. Do not front-load into Vol.2 scripts.

onmyo_agency.role: Government agency overseeing the witchcraft world; monitors supernatural activity, combats spirits/demons; includes an Exorcism Bureau.
onmyo_agency.hq_location: Akihabara (INFERRED - commonly cited in-series; not independently re-verified this session)

onmyo_academy.role: School training licensed onmyouji; the 'Raven'-training academy Harutora and Touji transfer into. Also called Onmyo Prep School / Onmyo Prep Academy.

characters.name: Harutora Tsuchimikado
characters.role: Protagonist; son of a branch family of the Tsuchimikado clan.
traits: Born into a distinguished onmyouji family but with no magical powers / cannot see spirit energy (HARD_CANON).
Made a childhood promise to Natsume to become her shikigami and protect her (HARD_CANON).
Transfers to the Onmyo Academy in Tokyo to be with Natsume after parting with Hokuto (HARD_CANON).
Nicknamed 'Baka-tora' (Stupid Tiger) by Hokuto, Natsume, Touji, Suzuka (INFERRED from fandom/anibase).
Considers himself unlucky; bad at studies; kind, courageous, dense about others' feelings (INFERRED from anibase/japanpowered).

characters.name: Natsume Tsuchimikado
characters.role: Childhood friend / Tsuchimikado main-family heir (per clan tradition).
traits: Presents as male in front of other onmyouji families per clan tradition, hiding true gender (HARD_CANON).
Implied Yakou's reincarnation-adjacent figure (HARD_CANON - 'Yakou's supposed reincarnation' per multiple sources).
Has a Gohou-type shikigami named Hokuto, a true dragon spirit, used as a medium to be close to Harutora (HARD_CANON).
Gender-concealment reveal timing differs between LN/manga/anime - ADAPTATION DECISION REQUIRED (see continuity_risks).

characters.name: Touji Ato
characters.role: Childhood friend; Harutora's companion at the Academy.
traits: Illegitimate child treated as a 'demon' (HARD_CANON).
Host to a living-spirit ogre from a past spiritual disaster; laidback, dry wit (HARD_CANON).
Joins the Academy to control his inner ogre (HARD_CANON). Vol.2 Ch.5 'One-Armed Oni' centers on this.

characters.name: Suzuka Dairenji
characters.role: Prodigy onmyouji; later transferred into the Academy.
traits: Youngest member of the Twelve Divine Generals (elite First-Class Onmyouji) (INFERRED - shapes.inc/anibase; spec stated 'youngest ever First-Class Onmyouji').
Arrogant and harsh on the surface with a fragile, kind interior shaped by childhood experimentation by her parents (HARD_CANON).

Enrolled in the Academy as a penalty imposed by the Onmyo Agency for an incident she caused the previous year (HARD_CANON - Wikipedia ep.10; spec phrased as 'emotional/social correction', which is a softer paraphrase - use penalty framing).
Appears in Vol.2 continuity via the 'Tricks' chapter arc / later Academy enrollment; her full Academy arc peaks in LN Vol.3-4 (GIRL RETURN).

characters.name: Kon
traits: Diminutive fox-eared (fox-tailed) silver-fox spirit, wears miko-like clothing, wields a wakizashi (HARD_CANON).
Fiercely loyal to Harutora; gets jealous when he associates with other girls (HARD_CANON).
The 'something unfamiliar' Harutora brought to the Academy - he could not see/hear her until his spiritual awareness awakened (HARD_CANON - Vol.2 Ch.2 'Ears and Tail').
Hides a tragic, multi-layered past; later revealed as Hishamaru, one of Yakou's two legendary familiars (HARD_CANON, but the reveal is a LATER-volume beat - do not fully expose in Vol.2).

characters.name: Kyouko Kurahashi
traits: Supporting classmate; Kurahashi family heiress (INFERRED).
Appears in Vol.2 Academy arc as part of Harutora's new friend group.

characters.name: Tenma Momoe
traits: Supporting classmate; stealth specialist (INFERRED).
Appears in Vol.2 Academy arc.

characters.name: Hokuto
characters.role: Natsume's shikigami (appears as a girl); medium to be close to Harutora.
traits: Natsume's shikigami, used so Natsume could be near Harutora (HARD_CANON).
Vol.2 opens 'parted with Hokuto' - her departure/memory is the catalyst for Harutora enrolling (HARD_CANON - publisher summary).
Shares the name with another shikigami, a dragon (INFERRED).
